title: Sunday · the Lanes, all lit
logline: The bowling alley at dusk with every letter lit, the week before the ninth Dog Night. The last Sunday the sign is whole. The strip doesn't know; the reader with the sign table does.

panels.composition: Tier 1: SMALL WOOD LANES at dusk from across the highway, every tube lit, pink and blue, the lot half full, the hill behind.

image.notes: All fifteen letters lit. The last whole Sunday of the sign (objects.md sign table).
